headline: Week 1 Stuck at the Starting Line: SBF Opens With Five Scoreless Standoffs
html:
Week 1 Stuck at the Starting Line: SBF Opens With Five Scoreless Standoffs

The 2026 Stumblin Bumblin & Fumblin season has arrived, but the scoreboard has not. All five Week 1 matchups currently sit at 0.0-0.0, every team remains 0-0, and the league has produced more roster maneuvering than scoring. Nobody can claim victory, nobody has suffered defeat, and everybody still has time to pretend the draft went exactly as planned.

Week 1 Matchups

Chase’n Skattehoes 0.0, arupert12 0.0

Ja'Marr Chase and company are lined up opposite a roster anchored by Jalen Hurts, Jonathan Taylor and Justin Jefferson. For now, the only thing separating these teams is their place on the official board: arupert12 ranks third, while Chase’n Skattehoes enters eighth. The actual scoreboard remains completely unmoved.

OguguaAnunoby 0.0, Secret service chat 0.0

OguguaAnunoby brings the official No. 4 ranking into a matchup with ninth-ranked Secret service chat. Both teams have several notable starters carrying questionable designations, but no performances or points have been recorded. At 0.0 apiece, this matchup is still waiting for somebody to seize control.

Kirkumcised Penix 0.0, shmeems 0.0

The official No. 2 team faces No. 7 in a matchup featuring Jayden Daniels on one side and Lamar Jackson on the other. That is plenty of roster-level intrigue, but no scoring result yet. The scoreboard currently looks like it was left in the packaging.

Chef Boyardee 0.0, 4Anthony2 0.0

The official board favors fifth-ranked 4Anthony2 over 10th-ranked Chef Boyardee, but Week 1 has not provided evidence either way. Saquon Barkley, Malik Nabers and Garrett Wilson headline the Chef roster, while Josh Allen and Bijan Robinson lead 4Anthony2. So far, the score is still canned at 0.0-0.0.

alexvandeusen 0.0, Al-Qaeda Crashouts 0.0

The official championship favorite opens against the sixth-ranked team. alexvandeusen owns a 94 power score and the deepest odds position on the board, while Al-Qaeda Crashouts counters with an elite receiving foundation. None of that has reached the scoreboard yet, leaving another pristine 0.0-0.0 tie.

Biggest Win and Closest Game

  • Biggest win: None. Every matchup is tied 0.0-0.0, so no winning margin is supported by the current scores.
  • Closest game: All five matchups are tied for closest at a margin of 0.0 points.

1. alexvandeusen

Power score: 94. McCaffrey, Achane, Hall, Collins, Bowers and Burrow create elite balance, while Mahomes and Andrews provide exceptional bench depth.

2. Kirkumcised Penix

Power score: 91. Daniels, Lamb, Cook and Henry headline a formidable lineup, supported by strong receiver depth and Kelce on the bench.

3. arupert12

Power score: 88. Hurts, Taylor and Jefferson anchor a polished roster with Higgins, Olave, Montgomery and Warren supplying excellent balance.

4. OguguaAnunoby

Power score: 85. Gibbs leads a deep skill group featuring London, Metcalf, Kittle, Walker and Jacobs, though several starters carry questionable designations.

5. 4Anthony2

Power score: 82. Josh Allen, Bijan Robinson and Omarion Hampton offer a powerful core, complemented by solid receiver depth and two capable tight ends.

6. Al-Qaeda Crashouts

Power score: 79. St. Brown, A.J. Brown and McBride form an elite receiving foundation, with Williams and Irving balancing uncertainty at quarterback.

7. shmeems

Power score: 76. Lamar Jackson, Nacua, Rice and LaPorta provide major upside, but the running back group is youthful and carries several questionable designations.

8. Chase’n Skattehoes

Power score: 73. Ja'Marr Chase, McConkey, Pickens and Chase Brown create a strong core, while Caleb Williams and several young starters add upside.

9. Secret service chat

Power score: 70. Smith-Njigba and Jeanty provide star potential, with Prescott, Adams and Etienne adding stability; overall depth is less imposing than higher-ranked rosters.

10. Chef Boyardee

Power score: 67. Barkley, Nabers and Garrett Wilson offer a strong ceiling, but Lawrence and an inexperienced running back group create more preseason uncertainty.

Fraud Watch

No convictions yet. A 0.0-0.0 league-wide scoreboard cannot expose a fraud because nobody has done anything to expose. Still, expectations are highest for alexvandeusen, Kirkumcised Penix and arupert12 as the official top three. The spotlight is on; the receipts are merely blank.

Stock Up

  • alexvandeusen: The official No. 1 team carries a 94 power score and +400 championship odds. That is the league’s strongest opening position.
  • Kirkumcised Penix: A 91 power score and +500 odds place the roster firmly among the early heavyweights.
  • The transaction desk: Completed free-agent moves, a completed waiver claim and a completed trade kept the league active before the scoreboard moved.

Stock Down

  • Chef Boyardee: The roster opens 10th with a 67 power score and +2150 odds. The meal may have a strong ceiling, but the official board currently labels it the bargain-bin special.
  • Secret service chat: Ninth place, a 70 power score and +1800 odds leave this team with early ground to make up.
  • The scoreboard: Fifty combined matchup points would have been something. Zero across the entire league is just a very expensive screensaver.

Weekly Awards

  • Top of the Mountain: alexvandeusen, for holding the official No. 1 ranking, a 94 power score and +400 championship odds.
  • Bench Luxury Award: alexvandeusen, whose official ranking rationale highlights Patrick Mahomes and Mark Andrews as exceptional bench depth.
  • Roster Headliner Award: Kirkumcised Penix, with Daniels, Lamb, Cook and Henry leading the official No. 2 roster.
  • Transaction Wire Award: alexvandeusen, attached to multiple completed free-agent transactions in the supplied activity.
  • Participation Trophy of the Week: All 10 teams, each sitting at 0-0 with 0.0 points for and 0.0 points against.

Set the lineups, monitor the questionable designations and remember: power rankings create pressure, but only scores create bragging rights. Right now the entire league is undefeated, winless and one bad decision away from getting roasted in the next SBF Network edition.
